question: How many filaments are present and which syllable range do they contain?
premises: They contain the syllables from ka onward.
The range extends up to and includes bha.
inference: The lotus has twenty-four filaments encompassing the syllables from ka to bha.
uncertainties: The exact internal sandhi in bhāntargatāni is noted but the token is kept fused.
plain_english: There are twenty-four filaments, and they contain the syllables from ka up to bha.
